_comment_about_this_file: This is your watchlist. Edit it freely — Claude reads it fresh every run and never writes to it. Add a product by copying one of the entries below and changing the fields. Remove a product by deleting its entry. Keep the JSON valid (no trailing commas).

_field_reference.key: Short snake_case ID used as the price-history key. Don't reuse keys.
_field_reference.name: Display name — shown in the email.
_field_reference.search_terms: 1-3 strings to search for in each store. More specific = better match. Include brand and size if you care.
_field_reference.max_price: Optional. If set, any price at or below this counts as a discount regardless of history.
_field_reference.stores: Which stores to check. Default both. Omit to check both.
_field_reference.notes: Optional free text. The agent reads it — useful for things like 'I need this brand specifically' or 'gluten-free only'.

products.name: Vegemite 380g
products.notes: Brand-loyal — don't suggest Promite as a like-for-like, only as a fallback if Vegemite is gone for 3+ days.

products.name: Rolled oats 1kg
products.notes: Brand doesn't matter, cheapest wins. Must be 1kg (not 500g or 750g).
